theory Peak_Aux
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

text \<open>Auxiliary lemmas for the peak estimate.\<close>

lemma pa_sin_abs_le: "\<bar>sin (x::real)\<bar> \<le> \<bar>x\<bar>"
  by (rule abs_sin_x_le_abs_x)

lemma pa_cmod_cis_minus_one:
  fixes a :: real
  shows "cmod (cis a - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin (a / 2)\<bar>"
proof -
  have ca: "cos a = 1 - 2 * sin (a / 2) ^ 2"
    using cos_double_sin[of "a / 2"] by simp
  have sa: "sin a = 2 * sin (a / 2) * cos (a / 2)"
    using sin_double[of "a / 2"] by simp
  have pyth: "sin (a / 2) ^ 2 + cos (a / 2) ^ 2 = 1"
    by simp
  have sq: "cmod (cis a - 1) ^ 2 = (2 * \<bar>sin (a / 2)\<bar>) ^ 2"
  proof -
    have "cmod (cis a - 1) ^ 2 = (Re (cis a - 1))^2 + (Im (cis a - 1))^2"
      by (rule cmod_power2)
    also have "... = (cos a - 1) ^ 2 + (sin a) ^ 2"
      by (simp add: cis_def)
    also have "... = 4 * sin (a / 2) ^ 2 * (sin (a / 2) ^ 2 + cos (a / 2) ^ 2)"
      unfolding ca sa by (simp add: algebra_simps) (simp add: power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
    also have "... = 4 * sin (a / 2) ^ 2"
      using pyth by simp
    also have "... = (2 * \<bar>sin (a / 2)\<bar>) ^ 2"
      by (simp add: power_mult_distrib power2_abs)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
    by (rule power2_eq_imp_eq[OF sq]) auto
qed

lemma pa_geo: "(\<Sum>m<M. (z::complex) ^ m) * (z - 1) = z ^ M - 1"
  by (induct M) (simp_all add: lessThan_Suc algebra_simps)

lemma pa_geom_sin:
  fixes phi :: real
  shows "cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (real m * phi)) * \<bar>sin (phi / 2)\<bar> = \<bar>sin (real M * phi / 2)\<bar>"
proof -
  let ?z = "cis phi"
  have dm: "(\<Sum>m<M. cis (real m * phi)) = (\<Sum>m<M. ?z ^ m)"
    by (simp add: DeMoivre)
  have h1: "cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (real m * phi)) * cmod (?z - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin (real M * phi / 2)\<bar>"
  proof -
    have "cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (real m * phi)) * cmod (?z - 1) = cmod ((\<Sum>m<M. ?z ^ m) * (?z - 1))"
      by (simp add: norm_mult dm)
    also have "(\<Sum>m<M. ?z ^ m) * (?z - 1) = cis (real M * phi) - 1"
      by (simp add: pa_geo DeMoivre)
    also have "cmod (cis (real M * phi) - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin (real M * phi / 2)\<bar>"
      by (rule pa_cmod_cis_minus_one)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have h2: "cmod (?z - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin (phi / 2)\<bar>"
    by (rule pa_cmod_cis_minus_one)
  have "2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (real m * phi)) * \<bar>sin (phi / 2)\<bar>) = 2 * \<bar>sin (real M * phi / 2)\<bar>"
    using h1 h2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  thus ?thesis by simp
qed

text \<open>Counting the indices \<open>i < N\<close> with \<open>i mod r = x0\<close>.\<close>

lemma pa_arith1: "P + x0 < N \<Longrightarrow> P + r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1"
  for P x0 N r :: nat
  by omega

lemma pa_arith2: "P + r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1 \<Longrightarrow> x0 < N \<Longrightarrow> P + x0 < N"
  for P x0 N r :: nat
  by omega

lemma pa_arith3: "P + q = N - x0 + r - 1 \<Longrightarrow> q < r \<Longrightarrow> x0 < N \<Longrightarrow> N - x0 \<le> P \<and> P < N - x0 + r"
  for P q x0 N r :: nat
  by omega

lemma pa_set_eq:
  fixes N r x0 :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}"
proof (rule set_eqI)
  fix i
  show "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} \<longleftrightarrow> i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}"
  proof
    assume H: "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
    then have iN: "i < N" and im: "i mod r = x0" by auto
    have dm: "i = x0 + (i div r) * r"
      using div_add_mod[of i r] im by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have lt: "i div r < (N - x0 + r - 1) div r"
    proof -
      have a: "i div r * r + x0 < N" using dm iN by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have b: "i div r * r + r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1" by (rule pa_arith1[OF a])
      have "Suc (i div r) * r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1" using b by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      hence "Suc (i div r) \<le> (N - x0 + r - 1) div r"
        by (subst Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le[OF r]) simp
      thus ?thesis by simp
    qed
    show "i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}"
      using lt dm by auto
  next
    assume "i \<in> (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}"
    then obtain m where mK: "m < (N - x0 + r - 1) div r" and i_eq: "i = x0 + m * r"
      by auto
    have s1: "Suc m * r \<le> (N - x0 + r - 1) div r * r"
      using mK by (intro mult_le_mono1) simp
    have s2: "(N - x0 + r - 1) div r * r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1"
      by (rule Nat.div_mult_le_self)
    have s3: "Suc m * r = m * r + r" by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have d: "m * r + r \<le> N - x0 + r - 1" using s1 s2 s3 by simp
    have e: "m * r + x0 < N" by (rule pa_arith2[OF d x0N])
    have iN: "i < N" using i_eq e by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    have im: "i mod r = x0"
      using i_eq x0r r by (simp add: mod_less)
    show "i \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
      using iN im by simp
  qed
qed

lemma pa_inj:
  fixes x0 r :: nat and A :: "nat set"
  assumes r: "0 < r"
  shows "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) A"
proof (rule inj_onI)
  fix m m' assume "m \<in> A" and "m' \<in> A" and eq: "x0 + m * r = x0 + m' * r"
  hence "m * r = m' * r" by simp
  thus "m = m'" using r by simp
qed

lemma pa_card:
  fixes N r x0 :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (N - x0 + r - 1) div r"
proof -
  have "card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = card ((\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r})"
    by (simp add: pa_set_eq[OF r x0r x0N])
  also have "... = card {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}"
    by (rule card_image) (rule pa_inj[OF r])
  also have "... = (N - x0 + r - 1) div r" by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pa_bounds:
  fixes N r x0 :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "N - x0 \<le> card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} * r
    \<and> card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} * r < N - x0 + r
    \<and> 0 < card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
proof -
  let ?t = "N - x0 + r - 1"
  have dm: "r * (?t div r) + ?t mod r = ?t" by (rule div_add_mod)
  have qr: "?t mod r < r" using r by simp
  have ar: "N - x0 \<le> r * (?t div r) \<and> r * (?t div r) < N - x0 + r"
    by (rule pa_arith3[OF dm qr x0N])
  have card: "card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = ?t div r"
    by (rule pa_card[OF r x0r x0N])
  have pos: "0 < ?t div r"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> 0 < ?t div r"
    hence "?t div r = 0" by simp
    hence "N - x0 \<le> 0" using ar by simp
    thus False using x0N by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
    using ar pos by (simp add: card mult.commute)
qed

text \<open>The periodic state is a unit vector.\<close>

lemma pa_is_state:
  fixes N r x0 :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)"
proof -
  let ?S = "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
  let ?M = "card ?S"
  have bd: "0 < ?M" using pa_bounds[OF r x0r x0N] by simp
  have Mr: "(0::real) < real ?M" using bd by simp
  have sM: "sqrt (real ?M) ^ 2 = real ?M" by (rule real_sqrt_pow2) simp
  have sq: "(1 / sqrt (real ?M)) * (1 / sqrt (real ?M)) = 1 / real ?M"
  proof -
    have "sqrt (real ?M) \<noteq> 0" using Mr by simp
    thus ?thesis using sM by (simp add: power2_eq_square[symmetric] field_simps)
  qed
  have term: "\<And>i. cnj (periodic_state N r x0 i) * periodic_state N r x0 i
      = (if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real ?M) else 0)"
    by (simp add: periodic_state_def sq[symmetric] of_real_mult[symmetric] del: of_real_mult)
  have "inner N (periodic_state N r x0) (periodic_state N r x0)
      = (\<Sum>i<N. if i < N \<and> i mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / real ?M) else 0)"
    unfolding inner_def by (simp add: term)
  also have "... = (\<Sum>i\<in>?S. complex_of_real (1 / real ?M))"
    by (rule sum.mono_neutral_cong_right) auto
  also have "... = of_nat ?M * complex_of_real (1 / real ?M)"
    by simp
  also have "... = 1"
  proof -
    have "of_nat ?M * complex_of_real (1 / real ?M) = complex_of_real (real ?M * (1 / real ?M))"
      by (simp add: of_real_mult)
    also have "... = 1" using Mr by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  finally show ?thesis unfolding is_state_def .
qed

text \<open>The QFT of the periodic state, before taking the modulus.\<close>

lemma pa_qft_sum:
  fixes N r x0 j :: nat
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "(\<Sum>k<N. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) * periodic_state N r x0 k)
    = (\<Sum>m<card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + m * r) / real N))
      * complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0})))"
proof -
  let ?S = "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
  let ?c = "complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real (card ?S)))"
  let ?th = "\<lambda>k::nat. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N)"
  have s1: "(\<Sum>k\<in>?S. ?th k * ?c) = (\<Sum>k<N. ?th k * periodic_state N r x0 k)"
    by (rule sum.mono_neutral_cong_right) (auto simp: periodic_state_def)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>k\<in>?S. ?th k * ?c) = (\<Sum>m<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r. ?th (x0 + m * r) * ?c)"
  proof -
    have "(\<Sum>k\<in>?S. ?th k * ?c) = (\<Sum>k\<in>(\<lambda>m. x0 + m * r) ` {..<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r}. ?th k * ?c)"
      by (simp add: pa_set_eq[OF r x0r x0N])
    also have "... = (\<Sum>m<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r. ?th (x0 + m * r) * ?c)"
      by (rule sum.reindex) (rule pa_inj[OF r])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have s3: "(\<Sum>m<(N - x0 + r - 1) div r. ?th (x0 + m * r) * ?c)
      = (\<Sum>m<card ?S. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + m * r) / real N)) * ?c"
    by (simp add: pa_card[OF r x0r x0N] sum_distrib_right)
  show ?thesis
    using s1 s2 s3 by simp
qed

text \<open>Probability of a peak outcome.\<close>

lemma pa_prob:
  fixes N r x0 j :: nat and c :: int
  assumes r: "0 < r" and x0r: "x0 < r" and x0N: "x0 < N"
  shows "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j =
    (cmod (\<Sum>m<card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}.
       cis (real m * (2 * pi * (real j * real r - real c * real N) / real N)))) ^ 2
    / (real N * real (card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}))"
proof -
  let ?M = "card {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0}"
  let ?psi = "2 * pi * (real j * real r - real c * real N) / real N"
  let ?th = "\<lambda>k::nat. 2 * pi * real j * real k / real N"
  have bd: "0 < ?M" using pa_bounds[OF r x0r x0N] by simp
  have Npos: "(real N :: real) \<noteq> 0" using x0N by simp
  have Mpos: "(real ?M :: real) \<noteq> 0" using bd by simp
  have qv: "qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j
      = ((\<Sum>m<?M. cis (?th (x0 + m * r))) * complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real ?M)))
        / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"
    by (simp only: qft_def pa_qft_sum[OF r x0r x0N])
  have fac: "\<And>m. cis (?th (x0 + m * r)) = cis (?th x0) * cis (real m * ?psi)"
  proof -
    fix m :: nat
    have e1: "?th (x0 + m * r) = (?th x0 + real m * ?psi) + 2 * pi * (real m * real c)"
      using Npos by (simp add: field_simps)
    have memb: "real m * real c \<in> \<int>"
    proof -
      have "real m * real c = of_int (int m * c)" by simp
      thus ?thesis by simp
    qed
    have e3: "cis (2 * pi * (real m * real c)) = 1"
      by (rule cis_multiple_2pi) (rule memb)
    have "cis (?th (x0 + m * r)) = cis (?th x0 + real m * ?psi) * cis (2 * pi * (real m * real c))"
      using e1 by (subst e1) (rule cis_mult[symmetric])
    also have "... = cis (?th x0) * cis (real m * ?psi)"
      using e3 by (simp add: cis_mult[symmetric])
    finally show "cis (?th (x0 + m * r)) = cis (?th x0) * cis (real m * ?psi)" .
  qed
  have sumfac: "(\<Sum>m<?M. cis (?th (x0 + m * r))) = cis (?th x0) * (\<Sum>m<?M. cis (real m * ?psi))"
    by (simp add: fac sum_distrib_left)
  have p1: "0 \<le> 1 / sqrt (real ?M)" by simp
  have p2: "0 \<le> sqrt (real N)" by simp
  have nv: "cmod (qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j)
      = cmod (\<Sum>m<?M. cis (real m * ?psi)) * (1 / sqrt (real ?M)) / sqrt (real N)"
    by (simp add: qv sumfac norm_divide norm_mult abs_of_nonneg p1 p2)
  have sM: "sqrt (real ?M) ^ 2 = real ?M" by (rule real_sqrt_pow2) simp
  have sN: "sqrt (real N) ^ 2 = real N" by (rule real_sqrt_pow2) simp
  show ?thesis
    unfolding prob_def nv
    by (simp add: power_divide power_mult_distrib power_one_over sM sN)
qed

end
